name: Channel Xero
summary: A 1.0.1 raid skip guide (5.6K views) and surge/dash ordering tips. He predicts the wandering Garou Thane will be patched.

insights.text: Best I've learned is to dash from a standstill, do the jump, and then follow up with two dashes. Dashes tend to slow you down, so they are typically last to be used. Trust me I had plenty of falls myself in learning it.

insights.text: Yeah he kept surprising me when I first went through the raid. I do suspect that he will be patched to either spawn when you go through the wind gate or to stay still. But for now he helps out a ton!

insights.text: @diddl41  Cast surge and phase dash. Surge off of the ledge, jump with the in air jump (the normal double jump) then use the 2 air dashes to land on the ledge.

insights.text: @Nidrocity  I will have to play around with it a bit to have full concrete stats for it, but normally I just dash facing the way I want to go. Sometimes Ill try to sprint right before and that might get me more, without noting which I am doing at the time it is hard for me to recall which it is. I will try a few things and get back to you.
